reason: Search Console, 11 Sep-8 Oct 2026: 1,464 impressions and 2 clicks across the five sites, and the pages published against unmeasured targets drew none. The cycles improve existing pages; no new page publishes until its query has a measured number.
rule: A new guide publishes only when its query (normalised) is a target in data/search_intelligence/<host>/target_query_set.json, i.e. it has Search Console impressions in the rolling 28 days or a measured volume in measured_demand.json. A held candidate is NOT marked processed, so the run after its query gets a number publishes it automatically.
